settings.raw_content_1: Our watches come in two face sizes, 32mm and 40mm. Our 40mm sizing is categorized as a Men's watch and 32mm as a Women's watch but sizing is a matter of personal style, wrist size and preference. Other than the face size, the watches are not gendered in any way. Choose whatever works best for you and your sense of style.
settings.raw_content_2: As long as the product is not visibly used or damaged we accept returns within 30 days for a full refund. If you decide the watch does not work for you just request a return label and shit it back to us, no questions asked.
